title: SOMtime the World Ain’t Fair: Violating Fairness Using Self-Organizing Maps
reasoning: The paper focuses on fairness auditing in unsupervised representation learning, specifically using Self-Organizing Maps to detect sensitive attribute leakage. While it utilizes the World Values Survey (which includes data on morals), it uses these as proxy features to detect demographic leakage rather than as a benchmark to evaluate religious or ethical reasoning in models.
